title: Morena Leader Accuses Chihuahua Governor of Slandering Her: She Represents “Corruption, Privilege, and Disloyalty”
author: La Jornada Editorial Staff
content:
_This article by[La Jornada Editorial
Staff](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/la%20redacci%C3%B3n) originally
appeared in the [October 23, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/23/politica/montiel-acusa-
a-maru-campos-de-calumniarla-representa-corrupcion-privilegio-y-deslealtad),
Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

The national leader of Morena, Ariadna Montiel, **" categorically" rejected
the "baseless" accusations** that the governor of
[Chihuahua](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/21/opinion/chihuahua-
justicia-o-conveniencia), the PAN politician María Eugenia Campos, made
against her about alleged ties to organized crime, and demanded that, if she
has evidence, she present it to the competent authorities.

> "I will not allow baseless accusations or slander to cast doubt on my career
> and honesty. The only thing they seek is to distract attention from what is
> truly important: **you and your government have violated national
> sovereignty** ," she replied to Campos, who in an interview claimed that the
> former Secretary of Well-Being has ties to drug trafficking.

She described the PAN politician as a "mythomaniac," as acting "in a cowardly
manner" and as conducting herself with disloyalty toward the country, toward
the people of Chihuahua and even toward those close to her.

> Whoever betrays the homeland and their friends will end up betraying
> everyone.
>
> Ariadna Montiel, president of Morena

She said she is proud that "a person like María Eugenia Campos points at me,
because that puts me on the other side of what she is and represents:
corruption, privilege, disloyalty. That is what characterizes her." She added
that Chihuahua and all of Mexico "deserve to know **what role US CIA agents
played in an operation carried out on national territory** , who authorized
their participation and who is the person responsible for the violation of our
sovereignty."

Instead, she said, she always goes "with her head held high, on the side of
the people and of those who have the least." She maintained that she has
worked to lift out of poverty thousands of people of Chihuahua who had lived
in abandonment, especially the Rarámuri people, "whom their governor
despises."

Paragraphs later, the president of Morena stressed: "Chihuahua has a
beautiful, brave, noble and loyal people. It's a pity it has a governor
totally different from those values of the people of Chihuahua: she is the
opposite of her people, she acts cowardly, she is a mythomaniac and she
conducts herself with great disloyalty toward those she governs, toward the
homeland and even toward her friends."

To conclude, she stated: "We will resist the onslaughts of rancid PAN-ism and
its government in Chihuahua and, of course, **the transformation will soon
arrive in Chihuahua** , because its people and its folks deserve a government
worthy of its magnificent people."
